baseline_models.focus_anchor: تُؤْتِىٓ أُكُلَهَا كُلَّ حِينٍۭ بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهَا
baseline_models.mechanism: The subject repeatedly brings forth edible yield across time, while permission and lordly nurture make that productivity governed and renewed rather than self-originating.

activation_trace.role: Supplies the emergence of crop and tree growth, making تُؤْتِىٓ an image of productive output.
Supplies tree and field yield as the concrete output denoted by أُكُلَهَا.
Supplies encompassing totality, extending the yield over every stated interval.
Supplies time, duration, and occasion as the recurring axis of productivity.
Supplies permission and authorization as the condition under which the yield appears.
Supplies gradual cultivation, repair, and completion as the sustaining function of the Lord.

changed_reading.before: A flourishing tree bears fruit repeatedly.
changed_reading.after: The focus presents a governed yield-system whose output is continuously renewed through authorization and sustaining cultivation.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: وَيَضْرِبُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْأَمْثَالَ لِلنَّاسِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ
baseline_models.mechanism: The example is actively fashioned and displayed so that perceivers can re-present it inwardly; the recurring yield is therefore also a repeatable cognitive device rather than botanical decoration.

activation_trace.role: Supplies the depicting and manifesting of an example so that it leaves an effect in another.
Supplies the struck and circulating example as the communicative form being presented.
Supplies perceiving by sight, hearing, or inward sensing, casting the people as active recognizers.
Supplies a reminder that makes an absent thing present again, which is the example's intended cognitive work.

changed_reading.before: God tells a comparison so people may remember its lesson.
changed_reading.after: God makes a perceptible pattern whose repeatedly observed yield keeps reactivating what people are liable to lose from awareness.

baseline_models.mechanism: Giving, edible share, and a human audience combine into a distributive model: the tree's worth lies in making nourishment or benefit available, not merely in possessing life.

activation_trace.role: Supplies giving and bringing something to another, turning fruiting into delivery.
Supplies an allotted edible share or provision, giving the yield a recipient-facing function.
Supplies comprehensiveness, making availability recurrent rather than exceptional.
Supplies humanity as the collective field to which the useful example is directed.

changed_reading.before: The tree's fruit demonstrates its own health.
changed_reading.after: The tree models life that proves its quality by continually delivering a share of benefit to people.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening uses the same permission-Lord construction for bringing people out of darkness into light. That recurrence revises the focus yield into repeated, authorized emergence into visibility and understanding: its fruit can be illumination delivered to people.

activation_trace.role: Supplies bringing something out of concealment, the opening's concrete transition assigned to the focus fruit's revelatory effect.
Supplies illumination as the destination and lets the recurring yield function as renewed visibility.
Supplies authorization in the opening and binds its transition to the same condition named in the focus.
Supplies sustained cultivation and completion as the lordly support behind the opening's human transition.
Anchors the transferred mechanism in the focus phrase بِإِذْنِ.
Anchors the sustaining side of the transferred mechanism in رَبِّهَا.

structural_cues: 14:1 has بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِمْ, while 14:25 has بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهَا.
The opening transition concerns ٱلنَّاسَ, and the focus parable is explicitly لِلنَّاسِ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated permission-Lord construction and the darkness-to-light movement; I infer that the repeated construction carries an enabling, revelatory function into the fruit image. A live alternative is that permission independently governs two acts without transferring their function.

changed_reading.before: Permission regulates when a healthy tree may produce.
changed_reading.after: Each authorized fruiting can be read as a renewed release of people from obscurity into perceivable light.

context_deltas.mechanism: The ordered movement from reminder, to remembered blessing, to gratitude, to promised increase turns recurrent fruiting into a feedback loop. The branch image of gratitude as a fresh shoot makes the loop botanical: received yield becomes recognition, recognition becomes gratitude, and gratitude opens further growth.

activation_trace.role: Supplies active reminding at the start of the sequence, making prior events newly present.
Supplies blessing and good condition as the remembered yield that calls for a response.
Supplies recognition of blessing and praise of its giver as the human return movement.
Supplies the branch-distant image of a fresh shoot emerging, allowing gratitude to be visualized as renewed growth.
Supplies explicit increase and growth as the next output of gratitude.
Anchors the feedback loop in the focus image of renewed growth and produce.
Anchors remembrance as the focus's stated human effect.

structural_cues: 14:5 commands reminding, 14:6 commands remembering blessing, and 14:7 places gratitude immediately before increase.
14:25 joins recurrent produce to the hope that people will remember.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered sequence and the fresh-shoot branch of ش ك ر; I infer a regenerative loop in which the promised increase becomes later fruit. A live alternative is a linear reward sequence with no return from increase to renewed remembrance.

changed_reading.before: The fruit periodically reminds observers of a stable truth.
changed_reading.after: Remembered fruit recruits gratitude, and gratitude regenerates the conditions for further fruit, so memory participates in the cycle it recognizes.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier parable makes deeds into fire-ash scattered by a violent wind until their producers cannot retain or command anything earned. Against that failed output, edible recurring fruit reads as consequence that remains substantial, available, and effective.

activation_trace.role: Supplies fire-ash as an already-consumed residue, the material opposite of usable yield.
Supplies a violent wind that makes things light and scatters them, explaining the loss of retained effect.
Supplies effective ability and possession, which the ayah negates for the producers of ash-like works.
Supplies acquired benefit or provision as the output that becomes unavailable in the ash model.
Anchors the contrast in a substantial tree-yield that can actually be received.
Anchors durability in output that repeatedly emerges rather than disperses after one event.

structural_cues: 14:18 and 14:24-25 both use parable constructions and evaluate what humanly consequential output remains.
The ash is unavailable to those who earned it; the focus yield is repeatedly brought forth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an ash-output that cannot be retained and a later edible output that recurs; I infer that the two parables contrast failed and durable efficacy. A live alternative is that the ash and tree images classify different people without making material retention itself the point.

changed_reading.before: Fruit signals abundance, while ash elsewhere signals failure.
changed_reading.after: The fruit's goodness includes durable efficacy: unlike scattered earnings, its consequence remains receivable and keeps arriving.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding ayah identifies the tree with an intelligible word and gives it a rooted vertical architecture; the next ayah negates that architecture by total uprooting, and the following ayah transfers stability to believing people through stable speech. The focus fruit therefore becomes the word's recurrent capacity to stabilize lives, not merely information produced by a sentence.

activation_trace.role: Supplies an intelligible expression broad enough to be a statement, identifying what the tree models.
Supplies rootedness and firmness as the word-tree's supporting base.
Supplies persistence and stability as the architecture that makes repeated output possible.
Supplies total removal from the root, exposing the inverse condition that prevents stable fruiting.
Supplies active strengthening and fixation, transferring the tree's structural property into a human effect.
Supplies settled trust in the heart as the human state receiving stabilization.
Supplies speech as belief or position, making the stable word an inhabitable orientation rather than bare sound.
Anchors the transferred human effect in the focus's recurring production.
Anchors stabilization as a temporal, repeatedly available effect.

structural_cues: 14:24 supplies fixed root and skyward branch; 14:25 supplies recurrent yield; 14:26 supplies uprooting and no stability.
14:27 repeats ث ب ت around ٱلْقَوْلِ and applies the action to believers in both worldly life and the hereafter.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a stable word-tree followed by God stabilizing believers through stable speech; I infer that human stabilization is a principal fruit of the tree. A live alternative is that 14:27 comments on divine support independently rather than naming the fruit's mechanism.

changed_reading.before: A sound doctrine stays rooted and keeps producing good teachings.
changed_reading.after: The rooted word is an architecture that repeatedly makes its recipients steady across changing times and even across the two lives.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later sequence commands spending from allotted provision, identifies fruits as provision, places them inside ceaselessly operating cosmic services, and then echoes the focus with giving from all that was asked. The focus fruit becomes a flow meant to pass through recipients rather than terminate in possession.

activation_trace.role: Supplies money or provision leaving possession through expenditure, assigning an onward path to received yield.
Supplies an allotted gift as the source from which expenditure becomes possible.
Supplies fruit as realized benefit, explicitly joining botanical output to human provision.
Supplies continuous customary operation, giving the provision system a ceaseless temporal infrastructure.
Supplies giving and bringing to recipients in a direct lexical echo of the focus's تُؤْتِىٓ.
Supplies encompassing totality in a second direct echo of the focus's كُلَّ.
Anchors the later circulation mechanism in the focus fruit as an allotted edible share.

structural_cues: 14:31 places giving before a day with no sale or intimate exchange.
14:32-34 moves from water and fruits, through continuous cosmic service, to gifts too numerous to enumerate.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies provision, spending, fruit, continuous service, and the lexical echo of giving from all; I infer that the good tree models circulation through recipients. A live alternative is that these later gifts only exemplify divine generosity and do not specify what the focus fruit does after receipt.

changed_reading.before: The tree continually supplies people with nourishment.
changed_reading.after: Its fruit is provision in motion: received from a sustained system, it is meant to be released again through human practice before circulation closes.

context_deltas.mechanism: Near the close, examples are tied to inhabiting the dwellings of earlier wrongdoers and seeing what action did; then every self receives the counterpart of what it earned, and the whole communication culminates in warning and remembrance. Fruit can thus be the consequence a rooted word keeps ripening in history before it is finally returned as recompense.

activation_trace.role: Supplies inhabiting a dwelling, turning earlier outcomes into an environment later people physically occupy.
Supplies disclosure and becoming manifest, making historical consequence perceptible.
Supplies the depicting example in the repeated clause, now attached to lived ruins and visible action.
Supplies an act being met by its corresponding return, giving consequence a final direction back to the actor.
Supplies acquired benefit or earnings as what each self has actually produced.
Supplies delivery of a message, framing the whole warning as something made to reach people.
Supplies the closing reactivation of awareness, echoing the focus's stated endpoint.
Anchors ripened consequence in the focus's concrete image of yield.
Anchors the historical disclosure in the focus's own example-making construction.

structural_cues: 14:45 repeats the focus phrase of striking examples after directing attention to inhabited remains and disclosed action.
14:51 moves from each self's earnings to exact recompense, and 14:52 closes with warning, knowledge, and recollection.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies material historical exempla, earned output, recompense, and a closing reminder; I infer that fruit can name consequences ripening through time and returning to their producer. A live alternative is that these are separate warning devices and that fruit denotes beneficial effect only.

changed_reading.before: The parable communicates a lesson that remains true in every period.
changed_reading.after: The rooted word repeatedly ripens into inhabitable historical consequences, and those earnings ultimately return to each producer.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it reads the fruit through an earlier death scene rather than through adjacent botany. It remains anchored by the exact recurrence of ء ت ي and ك ل ل in a polarity between fruit arriving every time and death arriving from every place. Downstream prose should present it as an intrasure echo or counter-image, not as proof that the two constructions are lexically equivalent or intentionally paired.

activation_trace.role: Supplies the arrival of death, affliction, or destruction as the dark polarity of bringing forth.
Supplies exhaustive coverage across every place in the earlier death scene.
Supplies the opposite arrival as emerging growth and produce.
Supplies edible tree-yield as the life-serving content of the later arrival.
Supplies exhaustive coverage again, now distributed over time rather than place.
Supplies the temporal field that reverses the earlier scene's spatial field.

changed_reading.before: The tree is fruitful at every time.
changed_reading.after: Its life-giving arrival fills time as comprehensively as the earlier condemned figure is besieged by death from every place.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it relocates fruiting from a planted organism to a protected social and logistical network, and it activates the branch-distant image of benefit arriving from elsewhere. It remains anchored in تُؤْتِىٓ أُكُلَهَا and لِلنَّاسِ, while 14:37 explicitly joins a valley without cultivation, inclined human hearts, provision, and fruits. Downstream prose should qualify it as a network analogy, not identify the focus tree with the sanctuary or claim a literal flood.

activation_trace.role: Supplies the exploratory image of a benefit arriving from a rain-fed land into a land without rain, recasting fruiting as transfer across places.
Supplies an edible share or provision as what the transfer delivers.
Supplies a valley as a channel, giving the no-crop setting a spatial conduit rather than a productive field.
Supplies negation and otherness in غَيْرِ ذِى زَرْعٍ, marking the absence of ordinary cultivation.
Supplies crop growth as precisely the productive capacity negated in the valley.
Supplies human hearts as inwardly heated centers that can become the social carriers of provision.
Supplies inward inclination, providing the motive force that draws people toward the barren place.
Supplies allotted giving as the provisioning function generated through the network.
Supplies fruit as realized benefit, the outcome that reaches a place unable to grow it ordinarily.

changed_reading.before: A rooted tree produces locally from fertile conditions.
changed_reading.after: A rooted good can organize attraction and transfer so effectively that a place without cultivation receives recurring social fruit.

strongest_changes: The repeated بِإِذْنِ رَبِّ construction turns fruit into authorized human emergence from obscurity toward light.
The 14:24-27 sequence makes recurrent fruit the stable word's capacity to stabilize people across times and lives.
The 14:31-34 sequence makes fruit a circulating provision sustained by continuous infrastructure and released through recipients.
The exact ء ت ي plus ك ل ل echo sets temporally pervasive fruit against spatially pervasive death.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah recurrence changed the focus from a static botanical compliment into several live mechanisms: revelatory release, regenerative gratitude, durable consequence, human stabilization, provision circulation, and an exploratory social orchard in a no-crop valley.
remaining_uncertainties: The transfer of the opening darkness-to-light function through the shared permission-Lord construction is abductive rather than grammatically required.
The gratitude-as-fresh-shoot branch is visibly anchored but branch-distant, so the feedback loop should remain qualified.
The death counter-image and barren-valley network are strong lexical or structural activations, not claims of exclusive intended interpretation.
